# Setup

Reads the three canonical CSVs computed elsewhere (not recomputed here -- this notebook is
plotting only). NOTE: `data/` is a symlink to the mounted lab server in this repo.

- `data/results/concordance/fixation_density_concordance.csv` -- individual vs.
  leave-one-out group, written by `calc_concordance_group.R`.
- `data/results/concordance/fixation_density_concordance_pairwise.csv` -- every pair of
  participants, written by `calc_concordance_pairwise.R`.
- `data/results/concordance/isc_fixation_timecourse.csv` -- windowed
  Adult-Adult/Child-Child/Child-Adult ISC, written by `isc_analysis.qmd`'s "Part 8b" export
  (population-matched to concordance's `valid_data==TRUE` adults -- see
  METHODS_DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-02, for why that match matters and how it was verified).
- `annotations/scene-cuts/all_clips_cuts.csv` -- manually annotated cut timestamps.

Saves figures to `figures/concordance/` (these are real analysis-result figures, not
sanity/parameter-decision checks -- those go in `figures/checks/` instead, e.g. from
`diagnostic_concordance.py`).

"Concordance" here is never "ISC" -- see `calc_concordance_group.R`'s header for the
naming rule (ISC is reserved for the Franchak-style x/y time-series analysis).

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggthemes)
library(glue)
library(here)

CONCORDANCE_GROUP_PATH    <- here("data", "results", "concordance", "fixation_density_concordance.csv")
CONCORDANCE_PAIRWISE_PATH <- here("data", "results", "concordance", "fixation_density_concordance_pairwise.csv")
ISC_PATH                  <- here("data", "results", "concordance", "isc_fixation_timecourse.csv")
CENTER_BIAS_PATH          <- here("data", "results", "concordance", "center_bias_timecourse.csv")
CUTS_PATH                 <- here("annotations", "scene-cuts", "all_clips_cuts.csv")
FIGURES_DIR               <- here("figures", "concordance")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Fixed categorical colors, matching the Python-generated figures from this same analysis
# (figures/concordance/*.png) -- NOT ggthemes::scale_colour_few(), which is reserved
# for the Adult-Adult/Child-Child/Child-Adult comparisons elsewhere in isc_analysis.qmd.
GROUP_COLOR    <- "#2a78d6"  # concordance, vs. leave-one-out group
ISC_COLOR      <- "#eb6834"  # ISC, pairwise
PAIRWISE_COLOR <- "#1baf7a"  # concordance, pairwise

BLOCKS <- list(
  frank  = c("frank_complex", "frank_objects", "frank_play"),
  sesame = c("sesameus_1", "sesameus_2", "sesameindia_1", "sesameindia_2"),
  slow   = c("slow_animals", "slow_hands", "slow_inanimate", "slow_people"),
  pixar  = c("pixar_birds")
)

concordance_group_raw    <- read_csv(CONCORDANCE_GROUP_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
concordance_pairwise_raw <- read_csv(CONCORDANCE_PAIRWISE_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
isc_raw_tc               <- read_csv(ISC_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
center_bias_raw          <- read_csv(CENTER_BIAS_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
cuts_raw                 <- read_csv(CUTS_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)

isc_theme <- theme_few(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        axis.minor.ticks.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.minor.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"))
```

```{r helpers}
# One row per (video, window) for a single metric: concordance-group is averaged across
# participants first (its raw file has one row per participant per window); the other two
# are already one row per window.
get_concordance_group <- function(video) {
  concordance_group_raw |>
    filter(video_name == video) |>
    group_by(window_start_s) |>
    summarise(value = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(window_start_s)
}

get_concordance_pairwise <- function(video) {
  concordance_pairwise_raw |>
    filter(video_name == video) |>
    transmute(window_start_s, value = mean_r) |>
    arrange(window_start_s)
}

get_isc <- function(video, comparison = "Adult–Adult") {
  isc_raw_tc |>
    filter(video_name == video, comparison == !!comparison) |>
    transmute(window_start_s, value = mean_r) |>
    arrange(window_start_s)
}

get_cuts <- function(video) {
  sort(cuts_raw$cut_time_s[cuts_raw$video_name == video])
}

# Mean distance from screen center (px), duration-weighted per participant then averaged
# across participants, from calc_center_bias.R -- lower = more central clustering.
get_center_bias <- function(video) {
  center_bias_raw |>
    filter(video_name == video) |>
    transmute(window_start_s, value = mean_dist_px) |>
    arrange(window_start_s)
}
```

# Part 1: Single-Metric Timecourse

```{r plot-single}
plot_single_timecourse <- function(df, color, title, ylab = "r") {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = window_start_s, y = value)) +
    geom_line(colour = color, linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(df$window_start_s), by = 5),
                        minor_breaks = seq(0, max(df$window_start_s), by = 1),
                        guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Time (s)", y = ylab) +
    isc_theme
}

p1 <- plot_single_timecourse(get_concordance_group("pixar_birds"), GROUP_COLOR,
                        "Concordance (vs. leave-one-out group) — pixar_birds")
p1
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fixation_density_concordance_timecourse.png"), p1, width = 12, height = 4)
```

# Part 2: Concordance vs. ISC Overlay

```{r plot-overlay}
plot_overlay <- function(video, metrics) {
  # metrics: named list of (df, color) pairs, e.g. list(Concordance = list(df=..., colour=...))
  combined <- map_dfr(names(metrics), function(name) {
    metrics[[name]]$df |> mutate(series = name)
  })
  colors <- set_names(map_chr(metrics, "colour"), names(metrics))

  ggplot(combined, aes(x = window_start_s, y = value, colour = series)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(combined$window_start_s), by = 5),
                        minor_breaks = seq(0, max(combined$window_start_s), by = 1),
                        guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
    labs(title = glue("Concordance vs. ISC — {video}"), x = "Time (s)", y = "r", colour = NULL) +
    isc_theme + theme(legend.position = "top")
}

p2 <- plot_overlay("pixar_birds", list(
  "Concordance (group)" = list(df = get_concordance_group("pixar_birds"), colour = GROUP_COLOR),
  "ISC (pairwise)"      = list(df = get_isc("pixar_birds"), colour = ISC_COLOR)
))
p2
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "concordance_vs_isc_timecourse.png"), p2, width = 12, height = 4)
```

# Part 3: Three-Way Comparison, with Cuts

```{r plot-three-way}
plot_three_way_with_cuts <- function(video) {
  metrics <- list(
    "ISC (pairwise)"                       = list(df = get_isc(video), colour = ISC_COLOR),
    "Concordance (vs. leave-one-out group)" = list(df = get_concordance_group(video), colour = GROUP_COLOR),
    "Concordance (pairwise)"               = list(df = get_concordance_pairwise(video), colour = PAIRWISE_COLOR)
  )
  cuts <- get_cuts(video)

  plots <- imap(metrics, function(m, name) {
    ggplot(m$df, aes(x = window_start_s, y = value)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = cuts, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_line(colour = m$colour, linewidth = 0.9) +
      labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = name) +
      isc_theme
  })

  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = glue("ISC / concordance (group) / concordance (pairwise) vs. cuts — {video}"),
      subtitle = glue("{length(cuts)} cuts (dashed lines)")
    )
}

p3 <- plot_three_way_with_cuts("pixar_birds")
p3
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "concordance_isc_vs_cuts_pixar_birds.png"), p3, width = 12, height = 9)
```

# Part 4: Cut-Locked Timecourse

Realigns each metric to time-since-most-recent-cut instead of absolute stimulus time,
pooling across every cut (and, for a block, every clip in that block), with a shaded
mean ± SEM band (binning relative time, truncating once too few cuts contribute a bin,
etc.) -- ported from an earlier Python exploration script (since deleted, see
METHODS_DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-02, "No Python plotting scripts for this analysis").

```{r cut-locked-helpers}
# Raw (unbinned) relative-time samples for ONE clip: for each window, time since the most
# recent cut in THIS SAME clip. Windows before the first cut have no reference cut and are
# dropped.
relative_time_samples <- function(df, cuts) {
  if (length(cuts) == 0) return(tibble(rel_time = numeric(0), value = numeric(0)))
  cut_idx <- findInterval(df$window_start_s, cuts)  # 0 = before first cut
  keep <- cut_idx > 0
  tibble(rel_time = df$window_start_s[keep] - cuts[cut_idx[keep]], value = df$value[keep])
}

# Bins (possibly pooled across multiple clips) relative-time samples; truncates to bins
# with at least min_n contributing samples.
bin_stats <- function(samples, bin_s, min_n) {
  samples |>
    mutate(rel_bin = round(rel_time / bin_s) * bin_s) |>
    group_by(rel_bin) |>
    summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(sem = sd / sqrt(n)) |>
    filter(n >= min_n) |>
    arrange(rel_bin)
}

# video_timecourses: list of (df, cuts) pairs -- one per clip in scope (a single clip, or
# every clip in a block). Relative time is computed per-clip, pooled before binning.
cut_locked_stats <- function(video_timecourses, bin_s = 0.25, min_n = 5) {
  samples <- map_dfr(video_timecourses, ~ relative_time_samples(.x$df, .x$cuts))
  bin_stats(samples, bin_s, min_n)
}
```

```{r cut-locked-plot-fn}
# scope: either a single video name, or a block name from BLOCKS (pools every clip in it).
build_video_timecourses <- function(scope, metric_fn) {
  videos <- if (scope %in% names(BLOCKS)) BLOCKS[[scope]] else scope
  map(videos, function(v) list(df = metric_fn(v), cuts = get_cuts(v)))
}

plot_cut_locked <- function(scope, bin_s = 0.25, min_n = 5, mode = c("indexed", "raw")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  metrics <- list(
    "ISC (pairwise)"                       = list(metric_fn = get_isc, colour = ISC_COLOR),
    "Concordance (vs. leave-one-out group)" = list(metric_fn = get_concordance_group, colour = GROUP_COLOR),
    "Concordance (pairwise)"               = list(metric_fn = get_concordance_pairwise, colour = PAIRWISE_COLOR)
  )

  stats_list <- imap(metrics, function(m, name) {
    tcs <- build_video_timecourses(scope, m$metric_fn)
    stats <- cut_locked_stats(tcs, bin_s, min_n)
    t0 <- stats$mean[stats$rel_bin == 0][1]
    if (mode == "indexed") {
      stats <- stats |> mutate(y = mean / t0, y_lo = (mean - sem) / t0, y_hi = (mean + sem) / t0)
    } else {
      stats <- stats |> mutate(y = mean, y_lo = mean - sem, y_hi = mean + sem)
    }
    stats |> mutate(series = name)
  })
  combined <- bind_rows(stats_list)
  colors <- set_names(map_chr(metrics, "colour"), names(metrics))

  n_cuts <- sum(map_int(build_video_timecourses(scope, get_isc), ~ length(.x$cuts)))

  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = rel_bin, y = y, colour = series, fill = series)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_lo, ymax = y_hi), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(x = "Time since most recent cut (s)",
         y = if (mode == "indexed") "Ratio to value at t=0 (cut onset)" else "r",
         colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
         title = glue("Cut-locked ISC / concordance — {scope}"),
         subtitle = glue("mean ± SEM across {n_cuts} cuts, truncated where fewer than {min_n} cuts contribute",
                          if (mode == "indexed") "; each series indexed to its own t=0 value" else "")) +
    isc_theme + theme(legend.position = "top")

  if (mode == "indexed") p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dotted")
  p
}

p4_pixar <- plot_cut_locked("pixar_birds", mode = "indexed")
p4_pixar
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "concordance_isc_cut_locked_pixar_birds_combined.png"), p4_pixar, width = 10, height = 5)
```

# Part 5: Summary Comparison Across Blocks

Collapses each metric's full timecourse to one number per block, to compare overall
synchrony level across blocks rather than its shape over time. For each metric, each
clip in the block is first averaged across all of its windows; those per-clip means are
then averaged to get the block's point estimate, with SEM across clips as the error bar
(so a block's answer isn't dominated by whichever clip happens to run longest / have the
most windows). `pixar` has only one clip, so it gets a point with no error bar.

```{r summary-by-block-helpers}
block_metric_summary <- function(block) {
  videos <- BLOCKS[[block]]
  metrics <- list(
    "ISC (pairwise)"                       = list(metric_fn = get_isc, colour = ISC_COLOR),
    "Concordance (vs. leave-one-out group)" = list(metric_fn = get_concordance_group, colour = GROUP_COLOR),
    "Concordance (pairwise)"               = list(metric_fn = get_concordance_pairwise, colour = PAIRWISE_COLOR)
  )
  imap_dfr(metrics, function(m, name) {
    per_clip <- map_dbl(videos, ~ mean(m$metric_fn(.x)$value, na.rm = TRUE))
    tibble(
      series = name,
      block   = block,
      n_clips = length(videos),
      mean_r  = mean(per_clip),
      sem_r   = if (length(per_clip) > 1) sd(per_clip) / sqrt(length(per_clip)) else NA_real_
    )
  })
}

summary_all <- map_dfr(names(BLOCKS), block_metric_summary) |>
  mutate(block = factor(block, levels = names(BLOCKS)))
```

```{r summary-by-block-plot, fig.height=5}
colors5 <- c(
  "ISC (pairwise)"                        = ISC_COLOR,
  "Concordance (vs. leave-one-out group)"  = GROUP_COLOR,
  "Concordance (pairwise)"                = PAIRWISE_COLOR
)

n_clips_label <- summary_all |>
  distinct(block, n_clips) |>
  arrange(block) |>
  glue::glue_data("{block} (n={n_clips})") |>
  paste(collapse = ", ")

p5 <- ggplot(summary_all, aes(x = block, y = mean_r, fill = series)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_r - sem_r, ymax = mean_r + sem_r),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.2, colour = "grey30",
                na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors5) +
  labs(title = "ISC / concordance (group) / concordance (pairwise) — mean r by block",
       subtitle = str_wrap(glue("Error bars: SEM across clips within block. Clips per block: {n_clips_label}"), width = 70),
       x = NULL, y = "Mean r", fill = NULL) +
  isc_theme + theme(legend.position = "top")

p5
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "metric_comparison_by_block.png"), p5, width = 9, height = 5)
```

# Part 6: Center Bias Following Cuts

Right after a cut, viewers tend to reflexively look toward screen center before they've had
time to find content -- a low-level orienting response, not real shared attention. If a
metric's cut-locked rise (Part 4) is driven by this rather than by people converging on the
same content, its cut-locked shape should track the cut-locked center-bias curve below:
mean distance from screen center (px), duration-weighted, pooled across participants
(`calc_center_bias.R`) -- lower = more clustered toward center.

```{r center-bias-curve, fig.height=5}
p6a <- map_dfr(names(BLOCKS), function(block) {
  cut_locked_stats(build_video_timecourses(block, get_center_bias)) |> mutate(block = block)
}) |>
  mutate(block = factor(block, levels = names(BLOCKS))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rel_bin, y = mean)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), alpha = 0.18, fill = "grey30") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~block, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Cut-locked center bias: mean distance from screen center",
       x = "Time since most recent cut (s)", y = "Mean distance from center (px)") +
  isc_theme

p6a
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "center_bias_cut_locked_by_block.png"), p6a, width = 10, height = 7)
```

```{r center-bias-reliability-build}
metrics_for_bias <- list(
  "ISC (pairwise)"                        = get_isc,
  "Concordance (vs. leave-one-out group)" = get_concordance_group,
  "Concordance (pairwise)"                = get_concordance_pairwise
)

center_bias_reliability <- map_dfr(names(BLOCKS), function(block) {
  bias_df <- cut_locked_stats(build_video_timecourses(block, get_center_bias)) |>
    select(rel_bin, bias = mean)
  map_dfr(names(metrics_for_bias), function(name) {
    metric_df <- cut_locked_stats(build_video_timecourses(block, metrics_for_bias[[name]])) |>
      select(rel_bin, metric_val = mean)
    joined <- inner_join(bias_df, metric_df, by = "rel_bin")
    tibble(block = block, metric = name,
           r_with_center_bias = cor(joined$bias, joined$metric_val, use = "complete.obs"),
           n_bins = nrow(joined))
  })
})

bias_summary <- center_bias_reliability |>
  group_by(metric) |>
  summarise(mean_r = mean(r_with_center_bias), mean_abs_r = mean(abs(r_with_center_bias)), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_r))
```

```{r center-bias-reliability-plot, fig.height=5.5}
colors6 <- c(
  "ISC (pairwise)"                        = ISC_COLOR,
  "Concordance (vs. leave-one-out group)" = GROUP_COLOR,
  "Concordance (pairwise)"                = PAIRWISE_COLOR
)

p6b <- ggplot(center_bias_reliability,
              aes(x = factor(block, levels = names(BLOCKS)), y = r_with_center_bias, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors6) +
  labs(title = "How closely does each metric's cut-locked shape track center bias?",
       subtitle = str_wrap("Pearson r between each metric's cut-locked curve and the cut-locked center-bias curve (mean distance from screen center), over the same relative-time bins. More negative = the metric rises as gaze clusters toward center -- i.e. more consistent with a center-bias artifact than content-driven attention.", width = 100),
       x = NULL, y = "r (metric vs. center-bias distance)", fill = NULL) +
  isc_theme + theme(legend.position = "top")

p6b
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "center_bias_reliability_by_block.png"), p6b, width = 10, height = 6)
```

# Part 6b: Center Bias Reliability by Clip

Same analysis as Part 6, one clip at a time instead of pooled by block -- `build_video_timecourses()`
already accepts a single video name as `scope`, so this reuses the exact same helpers. Clips have
far fewer of their own cuts than a pooled block (`slow`'s 4 clips have only **3 annotated cuts
each**, vs. 12 pooled; `pixar_birds` is identical to the `pixar` block since it's a block of one
clip), so `min_n` is relaxed to 3 and these curves are noisier than Part 6's -- read them as a
closer look at where a block's pooled result is (or isn't) consistent across its own clips, not
as more reliable than the pooled version.

```{r center-bias-by-video-build}
video_to_block <- enframe(BLOCKS, name = "block", value = "video_name") |> unnest(video_name)
ALL_VIDEOS <- video_to_block$video_name

VIDEO_MIN_N <- 3

center_bias_by_video <- map_dfr(ALL_VIDEOS, function(v) {
  cut_locked_stats(build_video_timecourses(v, get_center_bias), min_n = VIDEO_MIN_N) |>
    mutate(video_name = v)
}) |>
  left_join(video_to_block, by = "video_name") |>
  mutate(video_name = factor(video_name, levels = ALL_VIDEOS))
```

```{r center-bias-by-video-plot, fig.height=11}
p6c <- ggplot(center_bias_by_video, aes(x = rel_bin, y = mean)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), alpha = 0.18, fill = "grey30") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~video_name, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(title = "Cut-locked center bias by clip",
       x = "Time since most recent cut (s)", y = "Mean distance from center (px)") +
  isc_theme

p6c
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "center_bias_cut_locked_by_video.png"), p6c, width = 14, height = 11)
```

```{r center-bias-reliability-by-video-build}
center_bias_reliability_by_video <- map_dfr(ALL_VIDEOS, function(v) {
  bias_df <- cut_locked_stats(build_video_timecourses(v, get_center_bias), min_n = VIDEO_MIN_N) |>
    select(rel_bin, bias = mean)
  map_dfr(names(metrics_for_bias), function(name) {
    metric_df <- cut_locked_stats(build_video_timecourses(v, metrics_for_bias[[name]]), min_n = VIDEO_MIN_N) |>
      select(rel_bin, metric_val = mean)
    joined <- inner_join(bias_df, metric_df, by = "rel_bin")
    tibble(video_name = v, metric = name,
           r_with_center_bias = if (nrow(joined) >= 3) cor(joined$bias, joined$metric_val, use = "complete.obs") else NA_real_,
           n_bins = nrow(joined))
  })
}) |>
  left_join(video_to_block, by = "video_name") |>
  mutate(video_name = factor(video_name, levels = ALL_VIDEOS))
```

```{r center-bias-reliability-by-video-plot, fig.height=6}
p6d <- ggplot(center_bias_reliability_by_video, aes(x = video_name, y = r_with_center_bias, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors6) +
  facet_grid(~block, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "How closely does each metric's cut-locked shape track center bias? By clip",
       subtitle = str_wrap("Same as Part 6, computed per clip instead of pooled by block -- noisier (as few as 3 cuts per clip), missing bars mean too few overlapping bins to correlate.", width = 110),
       x = NULL, y = "r (metric vs. center-bias distance)", fill = NULL) +
  isc_theme + theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p6d
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "center_bias_reliability_by_video.png"), p6d, width = 13, height = 6.5)
```

```{r center-bias-reliability-by-video-table}
center_bias_reliability_by_video |>
  select(block, video_name, metric, r_with_center_bias, n_bins) |>
  arrange(block, video_name, metric)
```

---

# Part 7: Agreement Between the Two Pairwise Metrics, by Clip

How well do concordance (pairwise) and ISC (pairwise) agree with each other -- not vs.
center bias, just directly -- window by window, for each clip on its own (not pooled by
block; these are both already windowed timecourses on the same window_start_s grid, so no
cut-locking or realignment is needed here).

```{r pairwise-agreement-build}
AGREEMENT_COLOR <- "#6b5b95"

pairwise_agreement_by_video <- map_dfr(ALL_VIDEOS, function(v) {
  joined <- inner_join(
    get_concordance_pairwise(v) |> rename(concordance = value),
    get_isc(v) |> rename(isc = value),
    by = "window_start_s"
  )
  tibble(video_name = v, r = cor(joined$concordance, joined$isc, use = "complete.obs"), n_windows = nrow(joined))
}) |>
  left_join(video_to_block, by = "video_name") |>
  mutate(video_name = factor(video_name, levels = ALL_VIDEOS))
```

```{r pairwise-agreement-plot, fig.height=5.5}
p7 <- ggplot(pairwise_agreement_by_video, aes(x = video_name, y = r)) +
  geom_col(fill = AGREEMENT_COLOR, width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2)), vjust = ifelse(pairwise_agreement_by_video$r >= 0, -0.4, 1.2), size = 3.5) +
  facet_grid(~block, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Concordance (pairwise) vs. ISC (pairwise): agreement by clip",
       subtitle = "Pearson r between the two metrics' windowed timecourses, same clip, same window grid",
       x = NULL, y = "r (concordance vs. ISC)") +
  isc_theme + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p7
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "pairwise_metric_agreement_by_video.png"), p7, width = 11, height = 5.5)
```

```{r pairwise-agreement-table}
pairwise_agreement_by_video |> select(block, video_name, r, n_windows) |> arrange(block, video_name)
```
